parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM worker_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND mode = 'run') AS runs_24h,
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(sources_checked),0) FROM worker_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS sources_checked,
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(sources_failed),0) FROM worker_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS sources_failed,
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(items_new),0) FROM worker_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS items_new,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.seen_items WHERE status = 'done' AND delivered_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS leads_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.seen_items WHERE status = 'pending') AS pending_now,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.seen_items WHERE status = 'dead') AS dead_total,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.seen_items WHERE status = 'done' AND delivered_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS leads_7d,
  (SELECT value::int FROM public.settings WHERE key = 'lead_floor_7d') AS lead_floor

parameters.text:
={{ '📊 *RFP tracker — daily digest*\n' +
'Runs (24h): ' + $json.runs_24h + ' · sources checked: ' + $json.sources_checked + ($json.sources_failed > 0 ? ' (⚠️ ' + $json.sources_failed + ' failed)' : '') + '\n' +
'New items: ' + $json.items_new + ' · leads delivered: ' + $json.leads_24h + '\n' +
'Pending now: ' + $json.pending_now + ' · dead total: ' + $json.dead_total +
($json.leads_7d < $json.lead_floor ? '\n🚨 *Lead floor breach*: ' + $json.leads_7d + ' leads in 7d (floor ' + $json.lead_floor + ') — щось зламалось вище по трубі (A3)' : '') }}
